messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Increase the box X dimension from 33.0 to 42.9.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response: {"match": true, "confidence": 0.9, "reason": "The edited part shows a clear increase in the horizontal X dimension (length of the bottom arm) compared to the original, while the vertical Y dimension and overall shape (L-profile) are preserved, consistent with the instruction to increase the X dimension."}
